name: card-skill
description: Open-source agent skill that turns articles, notes, and arguments into checked publish-ready PNG cards: WeChat/blog covers, social posters, whiteboards, article diagrams, with optional Codex direction preview.

interface.shortDescription: Turn text into checked publish-ready PNG cards
interface.longDescription: card-skill is an open-source coding-agent skill with Quiet Paper renderers, templates, fonts, schemas, and output checks. It turns articles, notes, arguments, stories, and explicitly requested WeChat Reading highlights or statistics into polished PNG covers, social cards, whiteboards, and article diagrams. Not a website builder or UI kit. In supported Codex desktop sessions, it can optionally show a small direction preview before rendering.
defaultPrompt: Turn this article into a WeChat cover image
Make these notes into a social card set
Turn my WeChat Reading highlights and thoughts into a sourced card set
Make my WeChat Reading statistics into a monthly reading report
Draw this argument as a whiteboard card
Compress the key sections of this article into formula cards
